cohort: 729 patients who underwent Cesarean section with regional anesthesia at a single institution within a 6-month period.
finding: Backache and shoulder pain were the most frequent minor complications in patients who received regional anesthesia for Cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that regional anesthesia for Cesarean section was associated with various complications, including backache and shoulder pain, but overall satisfaction with the anesthetic technique was high.
